feynman_certification.listener_verdict: Honestly, this was sick. Opening with how traditional code treats words as arbitrary integer IDs immediately made sense to me as a programmer—like how enum values or hash maps have zero semantic distance. Beat 3 and 4 nailed the actual intuition of Word2Vec without dumbing it down into baby talk or over-academic math gibberish. The 'king minus man plus woman equals queen' example is classic, but explaining it as coordinate offsets in continuous space made it click way better.

thriller_metadata.physical_analogy: Isolated catalog index numbers versus a continuous spatial coordinate map
thriller_metadata.eureka_mechanism: Continuous Vector Projection without Non-Linear Hidden Layers
thriller_metadata.paradigm_shift: Discrete symbolic vocabulary replaced by linear geometric vector arithmetic
